Executive Summary

High-level overview of total revenue, profit, order volume, and key highlights across the two-year period.

The 2023–2024 period recorded 50,000 transactions generating $1,275,308 in total revenue and $510,548 in total profit, yielding an overall profit margin of 40.0%. Year-over-year performance shows revenue growth of +1.7% and profit growth of +1.6% from 2023 to 2024.

Discount Impact & Profitability Analysis

Assess how discount levels affect revenue, profit margins, and order quantities to evaluate promotional effectiveness.

Discount Effectiveness Assessment

  • Margin compression: Profit margins drop from 40.0% (no discount) to approximately nan% at high discount levels—a decline of nan percentage points.
  • Discounts are applied to 37.5% of all transactions, meaning the majority of sales occur at full price.
  • Moderate discounts (up to 10%) can stimulate volume without severely eroding margins. Deep discounts above 20% should be reserved for specific promotional campaigns with clear ROI targets.
  • Average order quantity shows only modest changes at higher discount levels, suggesting discounts are not driving significant volume increases.
